label: Order
caption: TURTLE MOUNTAIN BAND OF CHIPPEWA INDIANS, ET AL. V. MICHAEL HOWE, SECRETARY OF STATE OF NORTH DAKOTA
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, case No. 23-3655, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
